summary: unexpected TOKEN, expected one of: LIST
rationale: Each token must fit the current production.
An unknown statement cannot create a state.
Each open string or block needs its closing delimiter.

summary: state name must be a single word: NAME
rationale: The state lexer rejects an unquoted multiword composite name.

summary: composite state ID cannot have additional descriptions
rationale: A composite supports a label but not additional description rows.
